positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Much of my work centers on using influence to shape behaviors that improve outcomes—for individuals and for the company as a whole. My approach is deeply informed by years of maintaining open source software and fostering open communities. Day-to-day, that means making it easy, fun, and compelling for people to do the right thing.

What I Do

- Build and maintain critical frontend cloud infrastructure, supporting 20+ teams
- Drive adoption of the frontend vision and golden path through communication, influence, and hands-on collaboration
- Define and enforce code organization and governance standards across all frontend projects at Upstart
- Serve as a consultant for greenfield, high-impact frontend initiatives and complex company-wide projects
- Actively maintain 10+ shared packages and services with broad adoption
- Accelerate delivery by creating systems and processes that improve quality, performance, and developer experience
- Transformed delivery velocity: reduced new project setup from 4 months → 2 hours, and increased deployment frequency from 30x/month → 3000x/month

Noteworthy

🏆 Recognized as a Top Engineer at Upstart (2023)
🎤 Panelist at Vercel Ship (2023), Customer Advisory Board Member (2025)
🥇 Hackathon Winner, Upstart (2022)

positions.title: Owner, Public Speaker
positions.description:
Q Solutions is the entity I do paid freelance and contract work under. Over the years, the bulk of the work has been specific to web based medical imaging, but has included smaller contracts, like a portal for scheduling COVID vaccinations.

## 2017

Graduating from Bootstrap w/ help from Atomic Design - Techbash 2017 - Pocono Manor, PA

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Architect, build, and maintain a popular open source software medical imaging viewer (OHIF) and its family of libraries (dcmjs-org, cornerstonejs, etc.)
- Coordinate collaborative development efforts across multiple organizations and internal teams
- Consult on, and implement, web based medical imaging applications for clients with varied needs
- Improve DX by implementing comprehensive CI/CD and refactoring solutions to be decoupled and extensible
- Author detailed technical documentation on how to configure, extend, and deploy the OHIF Viewer
- Leverage Docker to model production environments; OpenResty (nginx), Lua, Orthanc, OHIF, and Keycloak
- Assist in community outreach to grow active contributors and foster a supportive environment

## Tech:

React, node.js, cornerstone.js, vtk.js, Electron, docker, Cypress, Percy.io, CircleCI, .NET Core, nginx, DICOM, DICOM Structured Reports, DICOM Segmentation, DICOMWeb, atomic design, pattern library (Docz), lerna (monorepo), web workers, service workers, image decoding, Webpack and Rollup (bundling)

## Responsibilities:

System design, project design, project management, technical writing, project lead, mentorship

## Noteworthy:

- Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI) grant recipient
- Published in JCO Clinical Cancer Informatics

Work completed as a subcontractor for Radical Imaging through Q Solutions LLC

positions.description:
Primary role to date has been to grow the company's product offering as a Web/Mobile application developer. Requires deep knowledge of Ellie Mae's Encompass SDK, AWS services, and various other technologies.

Customer Portal
  - C# .NET, MVC + Areas, Specflow, Selenium, XUnit 2, AutoMapper, Entity Framework, Git

  - VueJS, Canvas, AWS S3, PDFSharp, Migradoc, C# .NET, Gulp, Webpack, NPM
  - $36k/yr savings, also frees up Marketing department resources

## Noteworthy:

- Setup Jira, Jira integrations to Slack/Zendesk/Github, and Jira workflows/process
- Building out company's first ever tech product offerings

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
A Hackathon project turned LLC

A "text to vote" platform that integrates with existing Youtube, Spotify, and SoundCloud APIs. The solution captured user input using a combination of texts to Twilio registered numbers, emails, and mobile app interactions. The mobile app, voting, and creating a playlist were all free services; the ability to market back to users that had voted on your playlist and access to analytics were available at subscription rates.

vTxt had some moderate success at local Columbus businesses. However, we could not scale fast enough to make the work sustainable with the amount of financing we had available. Still a fun experience early in my career ^_^

Web:
- PHP
- BackboneJS

Mobile:
- Intel XDK + Cordova
- KnockoutJS

Integrated APIs:
- YouTube
- SoundCloud
- Spotify
- Stripe Payments

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
I was brought on to save a damaged relationship with an existing large and cornerstone client. The primary application utilized the following technologies:

- SharePoint
- C# .NET
- KnockoutJS
- Mult-threaded Windows Service

Interacting with:
- Microsoft High Performance Cluster (HPC)
- Linux PBS Job Scheduler

Over the course of six months, I drastically increased the application's stability (primary point of concern), added unit tests around core application functionality, formalized and simplified the release process. The situation was high pressure and provided little support, but by leveraging my experience and by providing ample communication, I was able to improve the client-customer relationship; receiving commendations from both the client and my employer.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
- SCRUM framework, UI Toolkits, atomic design, and other philosophies
- Migration of a legacy project to a new AngularJS + REST based technology
- Worked on a TDD team; Heavy focus on UX , and refining process

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
I joined Dynamit in 2014 as a Junior Developer. It boasted 5x the engineers of my previous employer, and had several large contracts with fortune 500 clients. It provided a great opportunity to surround myself with bright developers, and exposure to a more mature SDLC, sales, and planning processes. When leaving in 2015, I had been promoted to a Developer role and was leading smaller projects.

- Build enterprise C# .NET MVC applications with framework scaffolding to assist in Rapid Application Development
- Utilize Onion Architecture and Dependency Injection to decouple and create hot swappable layers
- Leverage atomic design and a pattern libraries 
- Experience with KnockoutJS and SammyJS to create localized SPAs.

Majority of projects require use of SASS/CSS and Photoshop to create the initial slice.

## Additional experience in:

- Providing support for an existing Android code base
- Working with PHP MVC projects
- Assistance in Architecting solutions
- Typescript

## Commendations:

- Clear/concise communication via e-mail
- Ability to learn quickly (trial by fire)

positions.title: Team Lead: Web Development
positions.description:
In 2013, Robintek was a small family run business. I joined their team as a college intern, but my responsibilities quickly grew and I was offered a full-time position. During my tenure at Robintek, I: 

- Revitalized the recruitment and internship process; doubling the number of software developers
- Corresponded with, and completed work for, over 60 client accounts
- Scoped work, conducted code reviews, and pair programmed to upskill engineering interns
- Improved company code quality and delivery by introducing concepts like CI and source control
- Enabled new avenues of sales by introducing new technologies: mobile websites, mobile apps, responsive design, etc.

My role at Robintek leveraged the following technologies:

ASP.NET, VB.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Wordpress, homegrown CMS, git, responsive design, cordova framework

Users can text to vote (or email to vote) for the next music video based on the videos on the playlist.  An android app was also created that allowed for entering different "playlist rooms", seeing vote options, and voting.
